tips: Frost usually ends around Sep 4 (NASA POWER): after that date the risk drops for cold-sensitive plants.
It is the season of strong heat (NASA POWER): water early or at dusk and mulch the soil with straw or dry grass.
Rotate crop families between beds each season (leaves, fruits, roots, legumes) to care for the soil.
